assessment: No first-party South Darfur/Nyala land-registry or cadastral source was found in the English and Arabic searches. Search results included national services unrelated to parcel geometry and non-government directories/news, which are not enough to establish a city-local registry. The result remains unknown rather than a negative claim. No official city/state land-registry portal, map viewer, or parcel service was established in these searches. Local news and directory references were not promoted to a positive registry claim.
